Scripts.OnAttributeChanged: if name == "index" then self:CallMethod("Update", value) elseif name == "target-slot" then self:CallMethod("UpdateTempEnchant", value) end
Scripts.OnClick: if button == "RightButton" then local unit = self:GetParent():GetAttribute("unit") or "player" CancelUnitBuff(unit, self:GetID(), self.filter) end
